source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "world-class city" OR "world class city" OR "worlding cities" OR "global city making"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"world-class city" OR "world class city" OR "worlding cities" OR "global city making",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("global city making" OR "world class city" OR "world-class city" OR "worlding cities")
